items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: I never played with Chris Kelly. I used to go see him, listen to him. I never played in his band.

ctx.x: Did you ever play with Chris Kelly?
I never played with Chris Kelly. I used to go see him, listen to him. I never played in his band.
Who was your favorite trumpet player that you liked in those days? Did you like Buddy Petit or Chris or Sam Morgan? Or who would be your favorite?
